output.body: Take the isomorph sum_to(n) equals 1+2+...+n, with base case sum_to(0)=0. To get sum_to(3), note that 3 + sum_to(2) gives the same total, so the function adds n to a call on n-1; the chain 3 + sum_to(2), then 2 + sum_to(1), then 1 + sum_to(0) stops because sum_to(0)=0 needs no call.
output.key_idea: A recursive function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller input until it reaches a base case that needs no further call.
